item.title: Episode 3: The $10k WordPress Retainer Scam & The Modern Jamstack
item.description: Alex and Morgan go live on the classic agency retainer: $10k a year to click Update Plugins. They unpack the fear product, then show the Office 360 Jamstack alternative — fixed scope, full ownership, zero plugin babysitting. Promo code STUDIO50.
